trust_decision.summary: A column/field name taken from a request payload is trusted as a SQL identifier: it is wrapped in a pair of literal backticks and concatenated into the listing condition, so a key containing a backtick closes the quoting and injects SQL; the decision has to be made at every point where a user-supplied name becomes an identifier, by passing it through the connection's identifier quoting instead of hand-built backticks.

landing_point.why: The advisory names DateFilter and the column name; this is the line where $key (the request-supplied column filter key) is wrapped in hand-written backticks and concatenated into the SQL condition.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory names the listing DateFilter and the 'columnFilters' contract; the Note module implements its own fieldFilter contract (a JSON string decoded in src/Note/MappedParameter/NoteParameters.php:37-39) for a different controller family, so a solver can call it a neighbouring feature rather than part of the reported flaw.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: ColumnFilter deliberately builds a dotted identifier for localised columns: getKey() returns $key . '.' . $locale (e.g. 'localizedfield.en'). It must stay one quoted identifier, so a fix that whitelists [A-Za-z0-9_] or quotes the dot-separated segments separately breaks every localised column filter. A fix must also keep the existing date guard (non-array filterValue -> InvalidArgumentException('Filter value for date must be an array'), src/Listing/Filter/DateFilter.php:41-43) and the synthetic page/pageSize pseudo-columns the mapper appends (src/Filter/Mapper/CollectionParametersMapper.php:72-88).

O6_input_shapes: plain string key on the date BETWEEN branch
plain string key on the date comparison branch (from/to/other operators)
key containing a backtick (must be doubled, not stripped)
date filterValue given as a non-array (already guarded, must stay an exception)
note fieldFilters delivered as a JSON string rather than a structured body field (field name + type + operator + value)
key with a locale suffix appended by ColumnFilter::getKey()

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a listing filter that turns an arbitrary user-supplied key into ORDER BY / GROUP BY, added as a peer of DateFilter/EqualsFilter/LikeFilter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The tag-based loader auto-registers any FilterInterface, the same request already carries sortKeys, and two sibling routes in the repo (Email, Notes) already pass a request key to setOrderKey, so a maintainer adding an ORDER BY filter would copy that pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another pseudo-field branch (e.g. cid/ctype/title) built by string-concatenating the raw field name instead of reusing the quoted field
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The 'user' branch already hand-builds a subquery with a raw interpolated field name, so extending the pseudo-field list the same way is a natural edit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a sprintf()-built identifier query whose caller passes a sortKey that is not on the ALLOWED_SORT_KEYS list
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The class shows the project's own whitelist idiom (lines 39-51, 177-180), so a new pagination caller reusing getPageForId() with an unvalidated key is a plausible copy.
